item.title: Uber Cuts 3,000 Jobs, Enforces Return-to-Office Policy
item.description: Uber announces a 10% workforce reduction, merging teams and mandating a three‑day office week as it refocuses on autonomous vehicles and growth.

item.title: Uber Cuts 10% of Workforce, Reshapes Rideshare Ops
item.description: Uber announces a 10% staff reduction—3,300 jobs—targeting management layers, remote roles, and consolidating engineering, delivery, and robotaxi units.
